name: Sensible Stock
author: Richard27

sections.description:
Sensible Stock helps WooCommerce store owners know what to order next, when to order it and which supplier to use.

Many stores still manage inventory with spreadsheets, manual checks or gut feeling. That often leads to missed sales from stockouts, too much cash tied up in inventory and slow purchasing workflows.

Sensible Stock uses your existing WooCommerce product, stock and order data to generate practical purchase advice inside the WordPress dashboard.

What Sensible Stock helps you do

  • See which WooCommerce products need to be reordered
  • Calculate purchase advice from sales history and current stock
  • Work with supplier fields directly on products
  • Store supplier purchase prices and lead times
  • Set minimum stock quantities by product or brand
  • Preview supplier-based reorder lists
  • See estimated purchase and sales value before ordering
  • Reduce stock shortages and overstock
  • Save time on inventory planning

Included in the free WordPress.org plugin

  • Purchase advice dashboard
  • Supplier management
  • Supplier fields on WooCommerce products
  • Product and brand minimum quantities
  • Lead time management
  • Safety stock based on supplier lead times
  • Create order preview grouped by supplier
  • WooCommerce HPOS compatibility
  • English and Dutch translations

English and Dutch

Sensible Stock is available in English and Dutch. This plugin includes bundled Dutch translation files for nl_NL, nl_NL_formal and nl_BE.

Optional paid upgrades

The free plugin is usable on its own. Paid plans may add extra workflow and analysis features such as automatic reports, advanced supplier order tools, cashflow insight, ABC analysis and seasonal stock logic.

Built for WooCommerce

Sensible Stock works inside WordPress and WooCommerce. It does not require a separate inventory management system.

Core inventory and order calculations are processed in your own WordPress installation.

More information:
https://sensiblestock.com

External Services

Sensible Stock includes the Freemius SDK for optional account connection, software updates, support, usage analytics and paid upgrades.

The plugin remains usable without connecting to Freemius. Data is only shared with Freemius after the site administrator explicitly opts in through the Freemius consent screen.

Freemius service terms:
https://freemius.com/terms/

Freemius privacy policy:
https://freemius.com/privacy/
sections.installation:
1. Install Sensible Stock from the WordPress plugin directory or upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/sensible-stock.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Open Sensible Stock in the WordPress admin menu.
  5. Configure suppliers, lead times and minimum quantities.
  6. Open the purchase advice dashboard to see what should be ordered next.
sections.faq:
Does Sensible Stock require WooCommerce?

Yes. Sensible Stock is built specifically for WooCommerce stores.

What does Sensible Stock do?

Sensible Stock analyzes your WooCommerce products, stock and order history to create purchase advice. It helps you see which products need to be reordered, which supplier to use and how much stock should be purchased.

Is Sensible Stock available in Dutch?

Yes. Sensible Stock is available in English and Dutch. Dutch translation files are included for Dutch, Dutch formal and Belgian Dutch WordPress sites.

Does Sensible Stock support HPOS?

Yes. Sensible Stock is designed to work with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage.

Is a Freemius account required?

No. The included plugin functionality remains usable without connecting a Freemius account. Freemius is used for optional opt-in account features, support, updates and usage analytics.

Does inventory data leave my website?

Core inventory and order calculations are processed inside your WordPress installation. Freemius only receives data after the site administrator explicitly opts in through the Freemius consent screen.

Does the free plugin include paid features?

The free WordPress.org plugin includes the listed purchase advice, supplier, minimum stock, lead time and order preview functionality. Additional workflow and analysis tools may be available through paid upgrades.

  • Improved plugin text and readme for clearer WooCommerce inventory positioning.
  • Added explicit plugin textdomain loading for bundled translations.

2.4.30

  • Fixed reorder advice calculations in the Create Order Preview.
  • Improved forecasting stability.
  • Improved compatibility with WordPress.org requirements.
  • Minor code quality and stability improvements.

2.4.29

  • Removed all feature restrictions and tier-based limits from included functionality.
  • Renamed all plugin identifiers to use the sensst_ prefix for WordPress.org compliance.
  • Added nonce verification to admin filter persistence.

2.4.19

  • Removed local feature gating from included inventory functionality.
  • Made all included inventory and purchase advice screens usable without a license key.
  • Kept Freemius for optional opt-in account features, updates and support.

2.4.18

  • Improved WordPress.org compatibility.
  • Improved inventory dashboard workflow.
  • Improved HPOS order data handling.
